integrity: Finite exact checks reproduce certificates and sample spectra; the infinite-family conclusion rests on the written analytic proof. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes only two homogeneous Markov-positive laziness gains for a fixed finite irreducible reversible bipartite kernel with 0<s<3-2sqrt(2). It does not optimize arbitrary edge kernels, indefinite factors, total variation, or floating point stability; publication priority remains a risk.
title: A spectral-gap exception to interval-optimal two-round stochastic consensus on bipartite chains
